data.text: Luke, I appreciate the goodwill, but you’re part of this fishing community now—you shouldn’t have to go without to earn our trust. My family has fished this lake for years, and I want it supporting all our families for years to come. Why don’t we each take 10 tons? That gives everyone $10,000, leaves 50 tons to replenish the lake to 100, and sets a fair limit we can repeat every month. I’ll commit to 10 if we all agree. John, would you support that instead?
